name: Port Hedland
notes: World's largest bulk-export port. BHP/Fortescue iron ore.

name: Dampier
notes: Rio Tinto's primary Pilbara iron ore export terminal.

name: Newcastle
notes: World's largest coal export port (thermal + coking).

name: Hay Point
notes: Major coking-coal export terminal in Queensland. Adjacent to Dalrymple Bay.

name: Gladstone
notes: Multi-commodity port; large thermal coal exports.

name: Richards Bay
notes: Richards Bay Coal Terminal — South Africa's primary coal export facility.

name: Samarinda (Muara Berau)
notes: East Kalimantan coal export area. Barge-loaded anchorage operations common.

name: Banjarmasin (Taboneo)
notes: South Kalimantan coal transhipment hub. Predominantly barge-to-vessel loading.
